role: Refine the P26 frame-save preference: the $ra save is preferred only over other frame-related insns. Against non-frame instructions its own priority/depend-count ordering applies, which is what retail keeps (ra save after the argument moves).
mechanism: gcc/haifa-sched.c rank_for_schedule(): the frame-store preference now also requires that the preferred insn is not the $ra save competing with a non-store insn; a frame store that stores $ra is never preferred over a non-frame insn.

evidence.note: instrumented ready list for fun_002144d8 showed sq ra (p13) tied with move s0 (p13); retail schedules the move first. Excluding $ra from the preference only against non-frame insns keeps the ra-vs-save ordering used by the P21 units (a blanket $ra exclusion measured +2/-26).
